source_text: Sisara fugiens ad Iahel alienigenam; clavum in tempus. Ecclesia ex gentibus hostem prosternit. Gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Sisera fleeing unto Jael foreign-woman; peg into temple. Church from nations enemy lays-low. Glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Sisera flees to Jael the foreigner; a peg through the temple >> Bible:Judges 4:17-22]]. The church from the nations lays the enemy low. Glory. Amen.
